purpose: Measure how the same frozen participant-disjoint A model responds when the 15 s inference grid changes from 7.5 s to 3 s, including score evidence and event replay. This is a bounded diagnostic, not production stride approval and not a new Formal G1 acceptance run.

a_reconstruction_scores.use: reuse A scores and A row/window identity; no A refit

a_reconstruction_event_reference.use: reference only; new A/B replay reports corrected prediction-level matching semantics

approved_cache.contract: 15 s / 7.5 s / imu_stats_v1 / approved eligibility and label contracts

frozen_population.exact_complete_definition: fixed cohort excluding only the two approved raw-undecodable event contexts below

denominator_use.234_fixed_context: all prediction-level replay and unmatched-prediction descriptive statistics; incomplete GT is retained when valid context exists
denominator_use.232_exact_complete: event recall and exact-complete stratification only

frozen_population.historical_support_annotation: read-only previous geometry/model-review annotation; not used to choose windows, scores, thresholds, events, or model versions

frozen_models_and_policy.participant_disjoint_binding: fold manifest valid participants; each participant scored only by the complementary outer-train model
frozen_models_and_policy.preprocessing: raw finite imu_stats_v1; no scaler, selection, resampling, or fitted transform

eventizer.approved_skip_rule: preserve processed-record and raw-undecodable skip contract; never fabricate a recording

grid_and_input_contract.grid_origin: per recording regularize_imu origin: first valid ACC/GYRO timestamp minimum
grid_and_input_contract.grid_end: per recording regularize_imu end: last valid ACC/GYRO timestamp maximum
grid_and_input_contract.valid_window: coverage >= 0.8; longest invalid run <= floor(2.0*10)=20 points; no hard gap; no negative segment; no segment crossing
grid_and_input_contract.labels: same frozen event labels for diagnostics only; labels never control window generation or inference
grid_and_input_contract.inference_context: all valid dense windows in every processed recording, including background windows
grid_and_input_contract.A_common_start_check: same stable window IDs and same A scores as reconstructed A artifact
grid_and_input_contract.B_feature_generation: independent diagnostic directory; no interpolation or copying of A scores to B
grid_and_input_contract.only_A_or_B_starts: retained and explicitly tagged; common starts are descriptive paired checks only
grid_and_input_contract.raw_preprocessing: approved parser/aggregation/regularize_imu path with approved malformed-row skip details

event_level_replay: duplicate/extra detection count relative to coverage
precision/F1 only when evaluator semantics support them

prediction_matching_semantics.coverage: GT event has any prediction with IoU > 0.25; independent of one-to-one matching
prediction_matching_semantics.one_to_one: existing evaluate_events greedy one-to-one matching by descending IoU
prediction_matching_semantics.matched_prediction_count: number of one-to-one matched prediction indices
prediction_matching_semantics.unmatched_prediction_count: predictions not used in one-to-one matches, descriptive only
prediction_matching_semantics.duplicate_or_extra_relative_to_coverage: matched_prediction_count - covered_gt_count, reported signed and nonnegative extra count when positive
prediction_matching_semantics.incomplete_gt_rule: prediction-level statistics use fixed234 truth context; exact232 recall exclusion cannot turn its associated predictions into confirmed false positives
prediction_matching_semantics.per_hour_fp: not reported without a valid monitored-time denominator
prediction_matching_semantics.false_positive_language: unmatched predictions are not asserted to be confirmed false positives under incomplete label coverage

metric_contract.support_and_event_change: separately identify label-support, score/selected-support, and event-outcome changes

comparison_and_stopping.A_reproduction_gate: A row/window identity, score reuse, threshold, and eventizer contract must pass before B interpretation
comparison_and_stopping.improve_worsen_rule: predeclared sign comparison; tolerance is absolute 1 ms for duration/gap quantities and 1e-12 for floating score/ratio quantities; values within tolerance are unchanged
stop_if: A replay cannot be verified against stable IDs and the frozen A score source
matched frozen model/threshold/eventizer artifacts are missing
wall, memory, or diagnostic disk budget is exceeded

resource_budget.deterministic_record_order: discover_raw_files order, cache-present processed records only
resource_budget.partial_rule: if budget stops execution, report PARTIAL and do not expand based on favorable results
